source.citation: Balisco, R. A. T. & Liao, T.-Y. (2025). An annotated checklist of fish species described from the Philippines. ZooKeys 1246: 1–287.
source.licenseScope: Article-body data only. The separate supplementary species list is ODbL and was not used.

sourceRelationship.casGbifStatus: A separately reviewed GBIF/CAS record for the same cited catalog number reports a different locality/date and remains held because CAS collection redistribution terms conflict with GBIF CC0 metadata.
sourceRelationship.independenceBoundary: This crosswalk is derived from the CC BY 4.0 article body, not from GBIF or the CAS collection database. It does not resolve or redistribute the held GBIF/CAS row.

limitations: This is a historical type-locality statement, not a contemporary ecological survey or a complete Ragay Gulf species list.
The article says Ragay Gulf and Luzon but does not establish a province, region side, or exact point geometry for the published Rogo Point label.
No current presence, abundance, catchability, fishing access, legality, safety, diet, or bait claim follows from the record.
nextAction: Find an authoritative locality reference for Rogo Point and continue screening the CC BY article for other explicitly named gulf type localities, keeping unlocated records unassigned to CALABARZON.
